slots.jd.community-hospital.about:
Summary
Pinebrook Medical Center is a community hospital committed to safe, compassionate care for every patient and family we serve. We are seeking a Graduate Registered Nurse to join our on-site nursing team in Toledo, OH. Candidates must hold a current Registered Nurse Licence and a Basic Life Support Card.
slots.jd.community-hospital.duties:
Duties
- Assess patients on admission and throughout each shift, and report changes in condition promptly
- Coordinate with physicians and the wider care team to carry out and update plans of care
- Give medications safely and accurately according to orders and hospital policy
- Monitor patient responses to treatment and record findings in the medical record
- Teach patients and families about their condition, medications and care after discharge
- Take part in bedside handoff to keep care consistent between shifts
slots.jd.community-hospital.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- Basic Life Support Card and an active Registered Nurse Licence are required; Advanced Cardiac Life Support Card is preferred
- 2 or more years of registered nursing experience
- Patient assessment and vital signs monitoring skills across varied patient needs
- Care planning and triage in a busy hospital setting
- Clinical documentation that is accurate, timely and complete
- Infection control practices in line with hospital policy
slots.r1.b1: Charts care planning updates in the patient record after each visit, reducing documentation errors flagged in chart reviews by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Shares vital signs monitoring results and changes in patient condition clearly at each shift handoff so the incoming nurse can continue care without gaps.
slots.r1.b3: Gives medications after a patient assessment to confirm readiness and check for side effects, lowering medication-related follow-up calls by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates with physicians on discharge planning, confirming orders, follow-up needs and patient instructions before each patient leaves the clinic.
slots.r1.i1: Graduate Registered Nurse at Harborview Community Clinic, responsible for accurate and timely charting in the patient record for each clinic visit.
slots.r1.i2: Graduate Registered Nurse at Harborview Community Clinic, giving medications safely and checking patient responses under the guidance of senior nursing staff.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level graduate registered nurse handling a small share of patient care at a community clinic with a supervisor close by. Contributes bedside handoff, vital signs monitoring and care planning, and holds a Registered Nurse Licence and a Basic Life Support Card.
slots.summary.2: Graduate registered nurse with a B.S.N. in Nursing from Lakeshore University, working on a defined part of patient care with a supervisor nearby. Applies vital signs monitoring, care planning and bedside handoff to keep care safe and consistent between shifts.
